name: lineup-analyst
description: Weekly start/sit lineup check for a Sleeper fantasy football roster: decides every starting slot (including the FLEX) using projections, injury/practice status, opponent, and lock timing, and names a bench swap when one is warranted. Use for "who should I start this week", "should I bench X", or a pre-kickoff lineup review. It reads Sleeper roster/matchup/player data directly and checks open-web news for close calls; league-wide news tracking belongs to trend-scout.

skills.name: Start/sit lineup check
skills.description: Decides start or sit for every rostered slot this week, with a reason and a confidence number per call, using Sleeper projections, injury/practice status, opponent, and kickoff locks.
examples: Who should I start at FLEX this week?
Should I bench my QB1, he's questionable?
Check my lineup before Sunday's games lock
